column4: Tornado skipped southeast for {{convert|4|mi|km|}} before lifting. Several structures were damaged, including a house that lost part of its roof.
column6: Several barns and outbuildings were damaged. Trees were snapped or uprooted.
column8: A garage and barn were destroyed. One home and a trailer were also damaged. Numerous trees were downed.
column9: Several houses were damaged and a barn was heavily damaged. Many trees were downed.
column10: A brief tornado downed numerous trees, damaged an elementary school and destroyed an outbuilding.
column11: Many large trees were felled, some of which fell on homes and caused damage. Two homes also sustained minor roof damage from the tornado.
column12: A steel building was destroyed, entire walls of brick business buildings were also destroyed. Thirty large trees were uprooted and two people were injured.
column14: A mobile home was destroyed and two other buildings sustained minor roof damage. A hangar/storage building was also destroyed at Cairo Regional Airport.
column15: Minor roof damage with downed trees reported.
column20: Brief tornado touched down over open land with no damage.
column21: Sources:SPC Storm Reports for 04/23/11, NWS Paducah, NWS Wilmington
